title: Your password manager can catch fake sites #shorts
description:
A password manager saves each login for one exact website address, so it won't offer to fill it on a lookalike phishing site. If autofill stays quiet, stop and check the link.

#cybersecurity #phishing #passwordmanager #privacy #shorts
sub: If you know this one sign...

points.d: each one is saved for one exact site.
one changed letter in the web address.
it won't offer your login there.

fix:
No autofill? Don't type it.
Check the link first
fix_sub: Open the site yourself, not from the message.
question: Do you use a password manager? Yes or No in the comments
